selectionProtocol.laterEvaluation: 2026 pre-epoch; never used for V3 selection
selectionProtocol.groupAcceptance: Validation loss improves by at least 0.001 and Brier does not worsen; test groups in fixed order.
selectionProtocol.confirmationGate: If selected specification loses to core by >0.001 loss or >0.001 Brier on Nov–Dec 2025, fall back to core. Confirmation therefore informs selection, not independent validation.
selectionProtocol.missingness: Train-only observed mean imputation; one gate per underlying absence; all missing-flag increments constrained <=0.
selectionProtocol.ageAndCommentRegularisation: 4x L2 penalty; no market, ROI, November 2026 or full-model V2 coefficients used in fitting.
selectionProtocol.intercept: Fixed zero: common race-softmax intercept is not identifiable.
